audit.whatIsWrong: Talon's R misnamed 'Shadow Assassin'; cooldowns field had no digits; two fields advise sidestepping Tangle-Barbs 'behind minions', but Riot's text says the tangle passes through units and grows when it kills an enemy or passes through a champion — minions do not block it; Neeko called 'he/his' in many fields; dos title referenced a 'silence' Neeko does not have.
audit.why: Kit text is authoritative; hiding behind minions vs Tangle-Barbs is actively wrong advice.
audit.corrected: Name fixed, real cooldowns added (E 12s rank 1, R 120/105/90), minion-block advice replaced with lateral sidestep, pronouns fixed, silence title replaced.
